verdict.rationale: Puzzle is an AI-powered accounting product, so a buyer could fairly ask whether it offers a training opt-out or a no-training data commitment; the axis applies. However, nothing in the evidence pack covers AI model training, data-use policies or opt-out controls. The MCP write-access confirmation and data-export features are adjacent capabilities and do not count toward this story.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can prevent my data from being used to train AI models
